data.name: Minissha
data.gender_notes: Minissha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Minissha is derived from the Sanskrit word 'minis' which means 'intellect' and 'sha' which means 'lord'. The name signifies a wise and intelligent woman who is the ruler of her own mind and decisions. The name Minissha carries the meaning “Intellect, Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Minissha usually hope their child will grow to embody intellect, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the power of wisdom and intellect, Minissha is a divine inspiration for girls.
data.etymology: Minissha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intellect, Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Minissha total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

The name Minissha encourages women to embrace their intellect and assert their power and independence.
